# R&C Spaceworks - Retail & Commercial Design & Build

> Singapore retail and commercial design & build specialists.

R&C Spaceworks is a Singapore design and build company that specialises in retail outlets and commercial spaces, with its own carpentry workshop: shops and boutiques, offices and showrooms, cafes and service counters, salons and beauty studios. Services: integrated design and build, commercial carpentry, renovation, electrical works, tiling and flooring, painting and finishing, and audio, visual and lighting (AVL).

Contact: WhatsApp +65 8659 4553. Photos marked Real project show its own carpentry (decor added with AI styling); AI design concept images are ideas, not completed work.

## Services
- [Design & Build for Retail and Commercial Spaces](https://rcspaceworks.com/retail-commercial-design-build/): Integrated planning, design and project coordination for retail and commercial spaces, with one point of coordination from brief to handover.
- [Commercial Carpentry for Shops and Business Premises](https://rcspaceworks.com/services/commercial-carpentry/): Custom counters, cabinets, display shelving, storage and reception joinery, planned around your products, equipment and floor layout.
- [Commercial Renovation and Fit-Out for Shops and Offices](https://rcspaceworks.com/services/commercial-renovation/): Fit-out and refurbishment execution for shops and offices, from partitions and ceilings to making good and lease-end reinstatement.
- [Commercial Electrical Works for Shops and Offices](https://rcspaceworks.com/services/commercial-electrical-works/): Power points, wiring and general lighting installation for business units, planned with counters, equipment and layout.
- [Commercial Tiling and Flooring for Business Spaces](https://rcspaceworks.com/services/commercial-tiling-flooring/): Tiles, vinyl and SPC, and coated floors for business premises, with preparation and material choices matched to traffic and cleaning.
- [Commercial Painting and Finishing for Shops and Offices](https://rcspaceworks.com/services/commercial-painting-finishing/): Wall and ceiling painting, feature walls, surface finishes and touch-ups, including finishing for reinstatement.

## AVL
- [Audio, Visual and Lighting for Commercial Spaces](https://rcspaceworks.com/avl/): Sound, screens and feature lighting planned as one experience, with cable paths, power and controls settled during fit-out.
- [Commercial Audio Systems for Shops, Cafes and Offices](https://rcspaceworks.com/avl/commercial-audio-systems/): Background music, speaker zones, volume control and meeting-room audio basics, planned with the fit-out.
- [Display and Visual Systems for Commercial Spaces](https://rcspaceworks.com/avl/display-visual-systems/): Displays, digital signage, menu boards and presentation screens, planned for mounting, viewing distance, brightness and cabling.
- [Architectural and Feature Lighting for Commercial Interiors](https://rcspaceworks.com/avl/architectural-feature-lighting/): Feature, accent and display lighting with colour, glare and dimming scene control, planned with the fit-out.

## Spaces
- [Retail Shop and Boutique Fit-Out in Singapore](https://rcspaceworks.com/spaces/retail-shops-boutiques/): Shelving, counters, flooring, lighting and finishes for boutiques, specialty shops and mall kiosks, planned around how your stock and customers move.
- [Office and Showroom Fit-Out in Singapore](https://rcspaceworks.com/spaces/offices-showrooms/): Reception counters, feature walls, meeting rooms and product display for offices and showrooms, with lighting and screens planned alongside the joinery.
- [Cafe Counters, Seating and Service Areas](https://rcspaceworks.com/spaces/cafes-service-counters/): Service counters, display cabinets, seating zones, finishes and menu screens for cafes and customer-facing counters.
- [Salon and Beauty Studio Fit-Out in Singapore](https://rcspaceworks.com/spaces/salons-beauty-studios/): Mirrored stations, concealed storage, reception counters and flattering lighting for hair salons, nail bars and beauty studios.

## Guides
- [How to Brief a Shop Fit-Out](https://rcspaceworks.com/guides/how-to-brief-a-shop-fit-out/): What to prepare before you speak to any contractor, and how to compare shop fit-out quotations on like-for-like scope.
- [Retail Display Shelving Materials Compared](https://rcspaceworks.com/guides/retail-display-shelving-materials/): Laminate, veneer, solid wood, metal, glass and acrylic compared for durability, load, cleaning, look and cost drivers.
- [Planning a Custom Shop Counter](https://rcspaceworks.com/guides/planning-a-custom-shop-counter/): How to plan a custom shop counter: functions, typical heights, accessibility, materials, and power and data points.
- [Small Shop Renovation Checklist](https://rcspaceworks.com/guides/small-shop-renovation-checklist/): A step-by-step checklist from lease review and landlord approvals through handover, defects and lease-end reinstatement.
- [Lighting a Retail Display](https://rcspaceworks.com/guides/lighting-a-retail-display/): Plan display lighting in layers, with notes on colour temperature, colour rendering, glare, aiming and dimming.
- [Background Music for Shops](https://rcspaceworks.com/guides/background-music-for-shops/): Plan shop background music: speaker placement, zoning, volume, sources, staff control and licensing questions to check.
